description: Application for an Indian passport requiring proof of present address, date of birth, and identity.

requirements.name: Proof of Present Address
requirements.description: Valid address proof such as Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill, Water Bill, Telephone Bill, or Bank Passbook.
requirements.validation_hints: Address must match the current residential address of the applicant and be recently dated if utility bill.

requirements.name: Proof of Date of Birth
requirements.description: Birth Certificate issued by municipal authority, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or School Leaving / Matriculation Certificate.
requirements.validation_hints: Date of birth must be consistent across all submitted documents without discrepancy.

requirements.name: Proof of Identity
requirements.description: Government-issued identity document such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Voter ID Card.
requirements.validation_hints: Full legal name and photo ID must match the applicant details.

requirements.name: Non-ECR Proof (Educational Qualification)
requirements.description: 10th standard (Matriculation) or higher educational pass certificate to qualify for Non-ECR (Emigration Check Not Required) status.
requirements.validation_hints: Name of applicant on educational certificate must match identity proof.
